name: Blueberry
summary: **Blueberry** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by DJ Short, who began the project in the [[country:US|United States]] Pacific Northwest in the late 1970s. A cross of [[purple-thai|Purple Thai]] and [[afghani|Afghani]] landraces, developed over several generations of selection. Some accounts trace the sativa side instead through a related Thai line. Short later shared the genetics with Dutch breeders.

sources.title: Origins of Blueberry, Flo, and others by DJ Short
